title: Aspire Veynom EX Pod Vape Kit
description: Please note: Batteries are NOT included with this kit. The Aspire Veynom EX Kit is a versatile and powerful vaping device that exudes both style and performance. Designed for vapers who enjoy flexibility, this kit uses a single 18650 , 20700, or 21700 external battery, making it a standout choice for those who prefer the convenience of interchangeable batteries. With the ability to deliver up to 100 watts of power, the Veynom EX is capable of satisfying the needs of both cloud chasers and flavour enthusiasts. Its external battery configuration not only ensures extended vape sessions but also offers the convenience of swapping batteries on the go. The kit's 2ml e-liquid capacity and easy top-fill system make it both user-friendly and efficient. Compatible with BP series coils , the Veynom EX allows for a diverse range of vaping experiences, from tight MTL draws to open DTL hits. The Aspire Veynom EX stands out with its customizable LED lights, featuring six distinct modes to align with your mood or personal style, thereby enhancing the visual appeal of your vape experience. Navigating the Veynom EX is a breeze with its 0.96" TFT color screen . This user-friendly display clearly showcases essential vaping information, such as power settings, temperature, and battery status. Its diverse output modes, including AUTO, WATT, VOLTAGE, BYPASS, TC, and CPS , cater to a wide range of vaping preferences. This kit is also compatible with the versatile BP series coils, accommodating different vaping styles, from a snug MTL draw to a more expansive DTL experience. The Aspire Veynom EX Vape Kit is a remarkable fusion of style and substance. It melds top-tier vaping functionality with an elegant, customisable design, promising an enhanced and enjoyable vaping journey. Browse our liquid vape range and select the ideal match for your kit sessions. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
